title: A busy Saturday at the local market

sentences.text_target: It is Saturday morning and the weather is very sunny.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ənd ðə ˈwɛðər ɪz ˈvɛri ˈsʌni/
sentences.text_native: C'est samedi matin et il fait très beau.

sentences.text_target: Tom looks inside his kitchen fridge because it is empty.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm lʊks ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz ˈkɪtʃən frɪdʒ bɪˈkʌz ɪt ɪz ˈɛmpti/
sentences.text_native: Tom regarde à l'intérieur de son réfrigérateur car il est vide.

sentences.text_target: He takes a small piece of paper and a blue pen.
sentences.phonetic: /hi teɪks ə smɔːl piːs ʌv ˈpeɪpər ənd ə bluː pɛn/
sentences.text_native: Il prend un petit morceau de papier et un stylo bleu.

sentences.text_target: He writes a short shopping list on the table.
sentences.phonetic: /hi raɪts ə ʃɔːrt ˈʃɑːpɪŋ lɪst ɑːn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
sentences.text_native: Il écrit une courte liste de courses sur la table.

sentences.text_target: Tom puts his wallet safely inside his jacket pocket.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm pʊts hɪz ˈwɑːlɪt ˈseɪfli ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz ˈdʒækɪt ˈpɑːkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Tom met son portefeuille en sécurité dans la poche de sa veste.

sentences.text_target: He opens the front door and walks down the street.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈoʊpənz ðə frʌnt dɔːr ənd wɔːks daʊn ðə striːt/
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre la porte d'entrée et descend la rue en marchant.

sentences.text_target: After ten minutes of walking, he arrives at the big supermarket.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈæftər tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ʌv ˈwɔːkɪŋ, hi əˈraɪvz æt ðə bɪɡ ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Après dix minutes de marche, il arrive au grand supermarché.

sentences.text_target: The automatic glass doors slide open for every customer.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˌɔːtəˈmætɪk ɡlæs dɔːrz slaɪd ˈoʊpən fɔːr ˈɛvəri ˈkʌstəmər/
sentences.text_native: Les portes vitrées automatiques s'ouvrent en coulissant pour chaque client.

sentences.text_target: Tom walks inside and grabs a shiny metal cart.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm wɔːks ɪnˈsaɪd ənd ɡræbz ə ˈʃaɪni ˈmɛtəl kɑːrt/
sentences.text_native: Tom entre et saisit un chariot en métal brillant.

sentences.text_target: He pushes the cart through the first wide aisle.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈpʊʃɪz ðə kɑːrt θruː ðə fɜːrst waɪd aɪl/
sentences.text_native: Il pousse le chariot dans la première grande allée.

sentences.text_target: He stops near the fresh fruit and vegetable section.
sentences.phonetic: /hi stɑːps nɪr ðə frɛʃ fruːt ənd ˈvɛdʒətəbəl ˈsɛkʃən/
sentences.text_native: Il s'arrête près du rayon des fruits et légumes frais.

sentences.text_target: Tom chooses three yellow bananas and some red tomatoes.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm ˈtʃuːzɪz θriː ˈjɛloʊ bəˈnænəz ənd sʌm rɛd təˈmɑːtoʊz/
sentences.text_native: Tom choisit trois bananes jaunes et quelques tomates rouges.

sentences.text_target: He places them on a small scale to check the weight.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈpleɪsɪz ðɛm ɑːn ə smɔːl skeɪl tuː tʃɛk ðə weɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il les place sur une petite balance pour vérifier le poids.

sentences.text_target: A small white price tag prints out from the machine.
sentences.phonetic: /ə smɔːl waɪt praɪs tæɡ prɪnts aʊt frəm ðə məˈʃiːn/
sentences.text_native: Une petite étiquette de prix blanche sort de la machine.

sentences.text_target: He sticks the paper price tag onto the plastic bag.
sentences.phonetic: /hi stɪks ðə ˈpeɪpər praɪs tæɡ ˈɑːntuː ðə ˈplæstɪk bæɡ/
sentences.text_native: Il colle l'étiquette de prix en papier sur le sac en plastique.

sentences.text_target: Next, he visits the cold dairy aisle for some milk and cheese.
sentences.phonetic: /nɛkst, hi ˈvɪzɪts ðə koʊld ˈdɛri aɪl fɔːr sʌm mɪlk ənd tʃiːz/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il se rend au rayon frais des produits laitiers pour prendre du lait et du fromage.

sentences.text_target: He takes a big carton of milk and a pot of yogurt.
sentences.phonetic: /hi teɪks ə bɪɡ ˈkɑːrtən ʌv mɪlk ənd ə pɑːt ʌv ˈjoʊɡərt/
sentences.text_native: Il prend une grande brique de lait et un pot de yaourt.

sentences.text_target: Then he walks quickly to the frozen food section.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hi wɔːks ˈkwɪkli tuː ðə ˈfroʊzən fuːd ˈsɛkʃən/
sentences.text_native: Puis il marche rapidement vers le rayon des produits surgelés.

sentences.text_target: Tom puts a box of frozen pizza inside his heavy cart.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm pʊts ə bɑːks ʌv ˈfroʊzən ˈpiːtsə ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz ˈhɛvi kɑːrt/
sentences.text_native: Tom place une boîte de pizza surgelée dans son chariot bien chargé.

sentences.text_target: He walks past the meat and fish counters.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks pæst ðə miːt ənd fɪʃ ˈkaʊntərz/
sentences.text_native: Il passe devant les comptoirs de la boucherie et de la poissonnerie.

sentences.text_target: The friendly baker offers him a piece of warm bread.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfrɛndli ˈbeɪkər ˈɔfərz hɪm ə piːs ʌv wɔːrm brɛd/
sentences.text_native: Le boulanger sympathique lui offre un morceau de pain chaud.

sentences.text_target: The shop smells wonderful with all the fresh ingredients.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ʃɑːp smɛlz ˈwʌndərfəl wɪð ɔːl ðə frɛʃ ɪnˈɡriːdiənts/
sentences.text_native: Le magasin sent merveilleusement bon avec tous ces ingrédients frais.

sentences.text_target: He needs some dry rice and pasta for dinners during the week.
sentences.phonetic: /hi niːdz sʌm draɪ raɪs ənd ˈpæstə fɔːr ˈdɪnərz ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə wiːk/
sentences.text_native: Il a besoin de riz et de pâtes pour les dîners de la semaine.

sentences.text_target: He finds a tall shelf with many glass bottles of water.
sentences.phonetic: /hi faɪndz ə tɔːl ʃɛlf wɪð ˈmɛni ɡlæs ˈbɑːtəlz ʌv ˈwɔːtər/
sentences.text_native: Il trouve une grande étagère remplie de bouteilles d'eau en verre.

sentences.text_target: Finally, Tom moves toward the front of the busy store.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli, tɑːm muːvz təˈwɔːrd ðə frʌnt ʌv ðə ˈbɪzi stɔːr/
sentences.text_native: Enfin, Tom se dirige vers l'avant du magasin animé.

sentences.text_target: There is a long queue at the main cash register.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə lɔːŋ kjuː æt ðə meɪn kæʃ ˈrɛdʒɪstər/
sentences.text_native: Il y a une longue file d'attente à la caisse principale.

sentences.text_target: Tom waits quietly in line behind another person.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm weɪts ˈkwaɪətli ɪn laɪn bɪˈhaɪnd əˈnʌðər ˈpɜːrsən/
sentences.text_native: Tom attend patiemment dans la file derrière une autre personne.

sentences.text_target: The cashier scans the items and tells him the total price.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə kæˈʃɪr skænz ði ˈaɪtəmz ənd tɛlz hɪm ðə ˈtoʊtəl praɪs/
sentences.text_native: La caissière scanne les articles et lui annonce le montant total.

sentences.text_target: He pays with his plastic card and takes the small paper receipt.
sentences.phonetic: /hi peɪz wɪð hɪz ˈplæstɪk kɑːrd ənd teɪks ðə smɔːl ˈpeɪpər rɪˈsiːt/
sentences.text_native: Il paie avec sa carte bancaire et prend son petit ticket de caisse.

sentences.text_target: With a big smile, he says thank you and heads back home.
sentences.phonetic: /wɪð ə bɪɡ smaɪl, hi sɛz θæŋk juː ənd hɛdz bæk hoʊm/
sentences.text_native: Avec un grand sourire, il dit merci et rentre chez lui.
